name: Banque Saudi Fransi
summary: Banque Saudi Fransi provides banking and financial services for individuals and businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury, and Investment Banking and Brokerage segments. It offers savings, current, and term deposit accounts; and mada Pay and Apple Pay products.
